description: This file defines an `AuthCodeRepository` class that implements OAuth2 authorization code management for persisting, revoking, and checking the revocation status of auth codes in the context of OAuth2 server integration within the application.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: Implements the OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface to manage OAuth2 authorization codes within the application's database, including persisting new codes, revoking existing ones, and checking revocation status.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the repository with a BeanManager instance for dependency management.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Persists a new authorization code to the database using details from the AuthCodeEntity.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an auth code as revoked or deletes it based on its auto-authorization status.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a specific auth code has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
